# <Game> - Game design document

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Status | Draft (living document) |
| Owner | game-designer (the user decides every design choice) |
| Last updated | YYYY-MM-DD |
| Source of truth for | The current design of the whole game, with every decided choice applied |
| Related | Bible (pitch, pillars, scope), decision log, design briefs, original GDD in `docs/reference/` |

**Summary.** The game in three sentences, as it stands today.

How to read: every rule carries a tag, **confirmed**, **proposed** or **to prototype**, and cites the decision (DEC-NN) or brief it comes from. Details live in the briefs and decision records; this document summarizes and links them. It is updated in the same run as any decision or brief that changes the design.

Premise, world, player goal. Pitch and pillars: link the bible, do not copy them.
